changelog: Added interactive zoomed-in 3D prop view (DUI) hiding the 2D screen overlay, with player Settings toggle and admin enforcement in /conf_acn_phone.
Replaced automatic nearby 3D screen streaming with on-demand 'Look over shoulder' target inspection, cutting idle CPU and network usage to zero.
Added a 'Show screen' quick action in Control Center and Android Quick Settings to share a live read-only view (HTML or 3D camera) with a nearby player.
Fixed rare blank 9:41 wallpaper state when opening certain phones.
